classes.label: clean
classes.summary: every source agrees and the amounts tie exactly

classes.label: rounding_noise
classes.summary: fee differs by at most two paise, within rounding tolerance

classes.label: refund
classes.summary: fully refunded; net settlement contribution is negative

classes.label: partial_refund
classes.summary: part of the order was refunded

classes.label: chargeback
classes.summary: sale reversed in a later settlement period, with a penalty

classes.label: unsettled
classes.summary: captured but not yet paid out; correctly unmatched

classes.label: failed_payment
classes.summary: attempt failed; no settlement will ever exist

classes.label: split_settlement
classes.summary: one settlement paid in several instalments that sum exactly

classes.label: duplicate
classes.summary: several captures for one order

classes.label: fee_mismatch
classes.summary: fee differs from the method's rule by more than tolerance

classes.label: ambiguous_match
classes.summary: several settlements fit equally well; escalated, not guessed

classes.label: missing_payment
classes.summary: order in the ledger with no gateway record

classes.label: amount_mismatch
classes.summary: ledger and gateway (or bank and settlement) amounts differ

classes.label: method_mismatch
classes.summary: ledger and gateway disagree on the payment method

classes.label: currency_mismatch
classes.summary: order recorded in a currency other than the settlement currency

classes.label: net_arithmetic_error
classes.summary: gross - fee - gst does not equal net on the gateway row

classes.label: dangling_settlement_ref
classes.summary: gateway row names a settlement the report does not contain

classes.label: unreversed_refund_fee
classes.summary: a refund was charged a fee that the rule table does not allow

classes.label: settlement_total_mismatch
classes.summary: member transactions do not sum to the settlement total

classes.label: settlement_not_in_bank
classes.summary: settlement reported but no statement line pays it

classes.label: orphan_bank_credit
classes.summary: statement line that corresponds to no settlement

classes.label: duplicate_bank_row
classes.summary: second credit for a settlement an earlier line already paid

classes.label: payout_reversal
classes.summary: debit returning a payout the books still show as settled

classes.label: missing_bank_row
classes.summary: running balance jumps: a statement line is absent
